Closely preserve her recognizable face outline, eye shape and spacing, eyebrows, nose, mouth, expression, exact head direction, chin tilt, gaze, hairstyle silhouette, shoulder angle and visible hand gesture. Reconstruct the ENTIRE body around the original photograph's pose, rather than placing a new head on a generic standing body. Clearly adult tavern waitress in her late twenties/thirties, attractive mature anatomy and a visibly large full bust, balanced proportions. Details: Preserve the first photo's turned head and gaze toward screen RIGHT, soft closed-lip smile, long flowing dark waves and white frangipani above the screen-LEFT ear. Keep the hand on screen RIGHT lifted to touch her hair and the other arm relaxed down, with the same shoulder slope and gentle hip shift. Extend the body naturally, no generic front-facing pose. Wardrobe redesign: Brilliant jade-green and magenta Sulu pirate tavern ensemble: gold-embroidered off-shoulder silk wrap top with a deep but tasteful neckline and secure opaque full-bust coverage, bare shoulders and midriff, asymmetrical vivid blue-and-magenta woven wrap skirt with side slit and a jewelled gold sash. Elaborate gold filigree earrings, layered pearl-and-turquoise necklaces, ruby hair ornaments beside the frangipani, gold upper-arm cuffs and many bangles. Tropical jewel colours with lavish metallic trim. Preserve face likeness above generic beauty conventions; do not give every woman the same face or smile. Adult head/body scale, natural neck and shoulders, around 7.5-head standing-equivalent anatomy. Head should not look enlarged relative to shoulders or torso. Rich, sexy, nonconservative fashion with brightly coloured opaque fabric, open neckline, bare shoulders or waist and lavish jewellery; tasteful adventure-game glamour, no nudity or erotic action. Render a refined semi-realistic hand-painted digital oil portrait with believable fabric, metal and skin, natural facial texture and cohesive lighting. Exactly ONE character, head through BOTH KNEES, vertical 1024x1536. Keep all hair, elbows, fingers and ornaments inside the frame with margin; no feet or shins. Genuinely transparent alpha background. Small pose-supporting bench/rail/counter may be included only when specified, without scenery. No photograph inset, collage, panels, text, logo, watermark, opaque backdrop, glow or ground shadow.
